Stated Claim / Post Context:
The Daily Stewart This Week

If you didn't see Jon Stewart's Monday hosting of The Daily Show, his Main Story was about how deep MAGOP loyalty is to Trump after his weekend wooing Chinese President Xi, even when he offered to sell weapons to China -- with a special place frustration carved out for Susan Collins and her regular display of "feigned outrage."  It's very blunt -- and funny.Will Republicans Divorce Trump Over Xi Embrace? Probably Not | The Daily Show

Actual Article Body:
If you didn't see Jon Stewart's Monday hosting of The Daily Show, his Main Story was about how deep MAGOP loyalty is to Trump after his weekend wooing Chinese President Xi, even when he offered to sell weapons to China -- with a special place frustration carved out for Susan Collins and her regular display of "feigned outrage."  It's very blunt -- and funny.
